label: March notation
subgoals: Read each element's address order from its arrow
Count the operations in each element
Sum the operations over the elements for the complexity

label: Test time
subgoals: Multiply the complexity by the number of words
Multiply the operation count by the cycle time
Compare linear March tests with quadratic tests for large arrays

label: What each element buys
subgoals: Start with a write sweep for a known background
Sweep read-then-write in both orders to catch coupling and decoder faults
Repeat the test once per data background for word-oriented memories
